title: Maritime Environmental Safety Plan
description: Free Maritime Environmental Safety Plan template for maritime you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers pollution sources and controls (marpol), spill prevention and response, emergency contacts.

Pollution Sources And Controls (Marpol)

SourceRequirementControl measure
Oil (bilge, fuel, oily waste) - Annex IOily water separator, oil record bookNever discharge outside limits; maintain equipment
Garbage and plastics - Annex VGarbage management plan and record bookSegregate, store, discharge only where permitted
Sewage - Annex IVApproved treatment plant or holding tankDischarge only in permitted areas
Air emissions (SOx, NOx) - Annex VIFuel sulphur limits, engine certificatesCompliant fuel, scrubber or alternative
Ballast waterBallast water management planExchange or treatment as required
Noxious liquid substances - Annex IIProcedures and arrangements manualFollow cargo and tank cleaning procedures

Spill Prevention And Response

☐ Shipboard oil pollution emergency plan (SOPEP) onboard and understood

☐ Spill response equipment accessible and checked

☐ Bunkering procedure used with checklist; scuppers plugged and drip trays used

☐ Spill drills held; contacts to authorities listed

☐ Records kept: oil record book, garbage record book, ballast water record
